name: Rizuhble's Belly Slam Dynamo
rows: Teleport into the middle of them, then ult.
Pop it before you ult so they can't stun you out of it.
Get after Warp Stone if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Headhunter for it.
One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.
Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.
Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.
A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.
Knockdown before it lands, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex.
They stun you as you walk in.
Sell Headhunter for this, or Warp Stone if it's gone.
On Kinetic Pulse. Sell Rapid Recharge for this.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
changes: Round 13: new damage build (Kieran: Mystic Reverb etc. on his 1) — source (damage-style only): lockbuilds official 'Gun/Stomp DYNAMO' (Oct 18, built from top Dynamo players, updated daily): lane Headshot Booster, Mystic Burst, Extra Regen, Headhunter, Extra Charge, Sprint Boots, Recharging Rush; mid Enduring Speed, Tankbuster, Warp Stone, Superior Cooldown, Mercurial Magnum (Rapid Recharge optional); late Mystic Reverb, Spirit Burn, Unstoppable, Refresher, Witchmail (Juggernaut, Echo Shard optional). Imbues all on Kinetic Pulse (26s, 2 charges, 115 + 1.55x spirit, +135 at T3): it's the damage and the most-cast ability. Order: seemeta's most popular Dynamo order (60.9% WR, 2,090 games), pulse maxed first; the lockbuilds page shows no level-by-level order. Thresholds: pulse clears Mystic Burst's 80 from the first point (132 at 1.6k souls) and Mystic Reverb's 100; Tankbuster at 13.6k: pulse T3 about 315 vs 165; Spirit Burn at 38.4k: one T3 pulse (250 + 1.55x 142 spirit = 470) plus its Reverb echo (235) is about 700 vs 500.

Round 14: Witchmail out of rich (nothing in the build it's a pricier version of; its sell, Recharging Rush, was also the Counters sell). Divine Barrier added (Dispel Magic is in Counters). Lane box caption 'Losing lane?' and its sell names Unstoppable (the 12th slot). Dispel Magic no longer lists Yamato's grapple.

Round 15: ability order is now seemeta's most popular Dynamo order exactly (1132141443332242, Oct 5-19, 2,090 matches). Unstoppable moved to second in Late (32k instead of 51.2k): health sat at 4.8k from 11.2k to 44.8k souls on a hero that warps into the middle of fights; the official Gun/Stomp build also has it before Refresher. Counters now sell Headhunter and Echo Shard sells Recharging Rush (same job: refilling the pulse); the Counters description was 114 characters, over the game's 112 limit.
Round 17: Counterspell added to Counters (the build had none). Lane box caption 'Losing lane? Buy 1' like every other build.
Round 19: renamed to the public style name (Stomp Dynamo); items already match Lockbuilds' Gun/Stomp Dynamo (582936, Oct 19).
Round 20: late list to 78.4k: Boundless Spirit, Juggernaut (second health step) and Witchmail added from Gun/Stomp DYNAMO 582936's late boxes; Echo Shard last.

Round 23 (kit): checked Kinetic Pulse (115 + 1.55x spirit, +135 at T3, 2 charges at T1, -15% bullet resist at T2), Singularity T3 (+6% max health per second, 3.5s with T2). Spirit Burn and Mystic Reverb on Pulse meet their thresholds off two pulses; Lightning Scroll considered and rejected (its stun lands at 3s, inside the 3.5s Singularity). No changes.
Slot locked: Juggernaut moved out of the rich box (Kieran rule: tiny-gain expensive upgrades are Slot locked).
